entities.name: Januário Correia de Almeida
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Januário Correia de Almeida, Count of São Januário was a Portuguese colonial administrator, military engineer and a diplomat. He was created Baron of São Januário by King Luís I in 1866, Viscount of São Januário in 1867 and Count of São Januário in 1889. He was born in Paço de Arcos on 31 March 1829, a son of Januário Correia de Almeida and Bárbara Luísa dos Santos Pinto.
